formal_statement: ¬ ∃ (s : ℕ → ℕ) (c : ℕ), (∀ n : ℕ, s n ^ 100 ≤ c * (n + 1) ^ 101) ∧ PEqualNP.Search.SAT ∈ PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.SIZE s
plain_statement: The satisfiability language of the definitions root (CNFs with variables written in binary) is not decided by circuits of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in at most two (every gate counted) with at most c (n+1)^1.01 gates on inputs of length n, for any constant c: no size function s with s(n)^100 <= c (n+1)^101 for all n has SAT in SIZE(s). Open: no superlinear circuit lower bound is known for any explicit NP language (best printed bounds are about 5n over this basis). Conjecture; the program's target.
title: OPEN: SAT has no fan-in two circuits of size O(n^1.01)
